description: This file defines a PHP class `smpl_Quote_Sample` that generates a PDF template for an AOS_Quotes entity, including layout and dynamic content filling.

classes.name: smpl_Quote_Sample
classes.description: A PHP class that provides methods to generate a quote PDF with header, body, and footer content.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'AOS_Quotes', indicating the type of document.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML content for the quote PDF, including tables with quote details and items.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no header is used.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the PDF footer, including page number and date.
